finish.summary: Built L-shaped 3-cell base with 3 drained full-depth bins, all soil-filled and planted with basil (x2) and thyme (x1); structure locked with joint bolts and meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build completed as a compact L-shaped kitchen herb planter.

**Summary:** Three hexagonal bases (0,0,0; 1,0,0; 0,1,0) locked with joint bolts, each fitted with a full-depth drained bin, all three filled with soil and planted - two basil plants (young + harvest stage) and one thyme (young) to meet the herb varieties requested.
